cohort: Mothers with children aged 0-23 months in Ethiopia (n=2054)
finding: Factors associated with increased EIBF included delivery at a health facility and having children with a birth order of second-fourth, while caesarean section delivery, multiple births, and having a postnatal check-up were associated with decreased EIBF.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was associated with decreased EIBF.
